fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a threat actor creating a file named `wbemcomn.dll` in the `C:\Windows\System32\wbem\` directory over the network and loading it for a WMI DLL Hijack scenario.
fields.name: Wmiprvse Wbemcomn DLL Hijack
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\wmiprvse.exe" and module.path contains "\\wbem\\wbemcomn.dll"))
